#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Inspect quarterly_report.docx: unpack, pretty-print document.xml, summarize paragraphs."""
import os
import sys
import zipfile
import xml.dom.minidom as minidom

SRC = "quarterly_report.docx"
OUT = "unpacked"
PRETTY = "unpacked_pretty"

if not os.path.exists(SRC):
    sys.exit(f"ERROR: {SRC} not found")

# 1. Extract zip contents
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC) as zf:
    names = zf.namelist()
    zf.extractall(OUT)
print(f"Extracted {len(names)} entries to {OUT}/")
print("Zip entries:")
for n in sorted(names):
    print("  ", n)

# 2. Pretty-print document.xml for readable inspection
os.makedirs(PRETTY, exist_ok=True)
with open(os.path.join(OUT, "word/document.xml"), "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    raw = f.read()
dom = minidom.parseString(raw)
with open(os.path.join(PRETTY, "document.xml"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(dom.toprettyxml(indent="  "))
print(f"Pretty document.xml written to {PRETTY}/document.xml")

# 3. Summarize paragraphs: index, pStyle, text
W = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"

def qn(name):
    return f"{{{W}}}{name}" if name.startswith("w:") else name

def para_text(p):
    parts = []
    for t in p.getElementsByTagName("w:t"):
        if t.firstChild:
            parts.append(t.firstChild.data)
    return "".join(parts)

def para_style(p):
    for pPr in p.getElementsByTagName("w:pPr"):
        for style in pPr.getElementsByTagName("w:pStyle"):
            return style.getAttribute("w:val")
    return None

paras = dom.getElementsByTagName("w:p")
print(f"\nTotal paragraphs: {len(paras)}")
for i, p in enumerate(paras):
    style = para_style(p)
    txt = para_text(p).strip()
    if style or txt:
        print(f"[{i:3d}] style={style!r:20s} text={txt[:80]!r}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Pack unpacked/ back into quarterly_report.docx (stdlib zipfile, like ooxml pack.py)."""
import os
import zipfile

SRC_DIR = "unpacked"
OUT = "quarterly_report.docx"

count = 0
with zipfile.ZipFile(OUT, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:
    for root, _dirs, files in os.walk(SRC_DIR):
        for name in sorted(files):
            path = os.path.join(root, name)
            arcname = os.path.relpath(path, SRC_DIR)
            zf.write(path, arcname)
            count += 1

print(f"Packed {count} files into {OUT}")
